fullPassage: One well-known shift took place when the accepted view — that the Earth was the center of the universe — changed to one where we understood that we are only inhabitants on one planet orbiting the Sun. With each person who grasped the solar system view, it became easier for the next person to do so. So it is with the notion that the world revolves around the human economy. This is slowly being replaced by the view that the economy is a part of the larger system of material flows that connect all living things. When this perspective shifts into place, it will be obvious that our economic well-being requires that we account for, and respond to, factors of ecological health. Unfortunately we do not have a century or two to make the change. By clarifying the nature of the old and new perspectives, and by identifying actions on which we might cooperate to move the process along, we can help accelerate the shift.

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 place의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) (일이) 일어나다 — (B) 장소: (A)는 'take place(일어나다)' 숙어의 place, (B)는 강가의 '장소'를 뜻하는 명사 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 장소 — (B) (일이) 일어나다: (A)는 'take place(발생하다)'이고 (B)는 '장소'라 서로 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (A) 놓다 — (B) 장소: (A)는 '놓다'라는 동사 뜻이 아니라 'take place(일어나다)'임
❌ ④ (A) (일이) 일어나다 — (B) 순위: (B)는 '순위'가 아니라 앉아 쉴 '장소'임
det.tip: take place = (일이) 일어나다. place(명사) = 장소. 다의어라 문맥으로 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a period of one hundred years"

det.analysis:
❌ ① decade(10년) — 100년이 아니라 10년
❌ ② moment(순간) — 아주 짧은 시간이라 다름
❌ ③ weekend(주말) — 며칠 단위라 무관
✅ ④ century(세기) — '100년의 기간'이라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
det.tip: century = 세기(100년). a century or two = 100~200년

questions.passage: When this perspective shifts into place, it will be obvious that our __________ (economy) well-being requires that we account for factors of ecological health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.analysis: 빈칸은 뒤의 명사 well-being(안녕)을 꾸며 주는 자리라 형용사가 필요해요. 명사 economy(경제)를 형용사 economic(경제의·경제적인)으로 바꿔야 'our economic well-being(우리의 경제적 안녕)'이 됩니다.
det.tip: economy(경제, 명사) → economic(경제적인, 형용사). 명사 앞 형용사 자리

questions.passage: By __________ (clarify) the nature of the old and new perspectives, and by identifying actions on which we might cooperate, we can help accelerate the shift.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: clarify(동사) → clarifying(동명사). 전치사 By 뒤라 -ing 형태
det.analysis: 전치사 by 뒤에는 동사를 그대로 쓸 수 없고 동명사(-ing) 형태가 와야 해요. 뒤에 나오는 'by identifying'과 짝을 이루도록, 동사 clarify(명확히 하다)를 clarifying으로 바꿔 'By clarifying(명확히 함으로써)'로 만듭니다.
det.tip: By + 동사-ing (동명사): by clarifying, by identifying. 전치사 뒤 -ing

questions.passage: One well-known shift took place when the accepted view — that the Earth was the center of the universe — changed to one where we understood that we are only inhabitants on one planet orbiting the Sun. With each person who grasped the solar system view, it became easier for the next person to do so. So it is with the notion that the world revolves around the human economy. This is slowly being replaced by the view that the economy is a __________ of material flows that connect all living things. When this perspective shifts into place, it will be obvious that our economic well-being requires that we account for, and respond to, factors of ecological health. Unfortunately we do not have a century or two to make the change. By clarifying the nature of the old and new perspectives, and by identifying actions on which we might cooperate to move the process along, we can help accelerate the shift.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 경제는 생명체를 연결하는 물질 흐름의 '더 큰 체계의 일부' → part of the larger system
det.analysis:
❌ ① threat to the global market(세계 시장에 대한 위협) — 본문에 없는 부정적 서술
❌ ② copy of the older economy(옛 경제의 복사본) — 본문 논지와 무관
✅ ③ part of the larger system(더 큰 체계의 일부) — 경제가 물질 흐름의 '더 큰 체계의 일부'라는 새 관점 ←정답
❌ ④ rival of the natural world(자연계의 경쟁자) — 자연과 대립시키는 서술이라 문맥과 반대
det.tip: the economy is a part of the larger system = 경제는 더 큰 체계의 일부

questions.passage: One well-known shift took place when the accepted view — that the Earth was the center of the universe — changed to one where we understood that we are only inhabitants on one planet orbiting the Sun. With each person who grasped the solar system view, it became easier for the next person to do so. So it is with the notion that the world revolves around the human economy. This is slowly being replaced by the view that the economy is a part of the larger system of material flows that connect all living things. When this perspective shifts into place, it will be obvious that our economic well-being requires that we account for, and respond to, __________. Unfortunately we do not have a century or two to make the change. By clarifying the nature of the old and new perspectives, and by identifying actions on which we might cooperate to move the process along, we can help accelerate the shift.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 경제적 안녕을 위해 '생태 건강의 요인'을 고려하고 반응해야 함 → factors of ecological health
det.analysis:
❌ ① rules of the global economy(세계 경제의 규칙) — 생태 건강이 핵심인 문맥과 어긋남
✅ ② factors of ecological health(생태 건강의 요인) — 경제적 안녕이 '생태 건강 요인'을 고려할 것을 요구함 ←정답
❌ ③ leaders of every nation(모든 국가의 지도자) — 본문에 없는 대상
❌ ④ profits of large companies(대기업의 이윤) — 생태가 아닌 이윤 초점이라 문맥과 반대
det.tip: account for factors of ecological health = 생태 건강의 요인을 고려하다
